en.<p class=\"eyebrow\">Spring Pin</p> <h2>:
Spring Pin

Spring Pin

A pin formed by rolling spring steel sheet into a cylindrical shape, which presses against the hole wall with its own elasticity to stay in place. It is supplied in two types: the parallel type (a substitute for dowel pins and hinge pins, KS B 1339 / JIS B 2808) with a constant diameter along its entire length, and the light-duty type, which has a fine corrugated groove in the body to reduce insertion and retention force.
